contents.text:
No. The docs don't mention Unity, and no doc describes a Unity plugin or any game-engine integration.

What the framework does ship is in the features list. There are hosts for the terminal, Rider, an HTTP API and an MCP server. Its web side draws sites and chat widgets. Nothing there targets a game engine.

I searched the docs for "Unity" and "game engine" and found nothing. If you want to build one, the framework's hosts are the places to start.

Where to go next:

choices.label: Show me the hosts
choices.why: The ways an agent meets people: terminal, Rider, HTTP API, MCP.

choices.label: Show me what's coming
choices.why: The examples page lists what is built and what is planned.

choices.label: Tell me what you want to build
choices.why: I'll say which parts of the framework fit it, from the docs.
